description: Invest Kerala Global Summit 2025 aims to attract investments in key sectors identified by the state government for growth.
body_lead: The upcoming Invest Kerala Global Summit (IKGS2025) aims to generate maximum investments in key sectors which have been identified by the state government in its new industrial policy, State Industries Minister P.Rajeeve has said. The seven focus pillars are fostering entrepreneurship, enabling infrastructure, being IR 4.0 ready with robotic manufacturing, data analytical tools, etc., skillset upgradation for futuristic jobs sectoral ecosystems, being ESG compliant, and the ‘Kerala’ brand.
